Secure the agents you run, as a course you take at your own pace.

03How it teaches

Built from how people learn

Short lessons you control

Twelve slides a lesson, each with a transcript. Move at your own pace and go back whenever you like.

One growing assurance pack

After every lesson a lab asks you to produce real security work for your own agent system: threat model, identity design, containment plan, detection rules, incident runbook. The twenty-eight answers join into one pack you download at the end.

Frontier research, with sources

Lessons 21 to 28 teach what 2026 papers and incident reports changed: adaptive attacks, enforcement outside the model, containing your own agents, measuring poisoning, honest detection, MCP authorization, skills and identity. Every figure cites the page it came from.

Practice tools you can run

A policy tester and a trace spotter let you try deterministic guardrails and find injected flaws in an agent log, in your browser, with fixtures to download.

A worked case and a field guide

Every lesson has a case to read and practical guidance to apply, so the ideas are tied to decisions you will actually make.

Mark your own work

Each lab has a model solution and a four-criterion rubric. Score yourself 0, 1 or 2 on each, then close the gaps.

Pause and recall

Three questions at the end of each lesson, with the reason for each answer. Your progress is stored in this browser only.

Retrieval practice and spacing are among the best-studied learning techniques, so each lesson ends by asking what you remember before it shows you.

    06Questions

    Before you decide

    Who is this for?

    Engineers, architects, security and risk people who run or are about to run AI agents that use tools, data and credentials.

    How do I get access?

    Message sales on WhatsApp. We reply with how to pay and send your access code when payment is confirmed.

    Can I share my code?

    Please do not. The code is personal and your name appears on every lesson.

    Will it be updated?

    Yes. The field moves quickly. We amend the course as standards and incidents change, and you keep every update.

    What about refunds?

    Refund terms are confirmed in writing when you enquire, before you pay.
